visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands centrally in a brightly lit indoor room, wearing a black sports bra and matching high-waisted underwear. She smiles warmly at the camera, her hair tied back with soft bangs framing her face. Behind her, a white wardrobe and a shelf filled with numerous small glass perfume bottles are visible against a light-colored wooden floor. She uses her hands to emphasize her speech, raising them to her chest and out to her sides in animated gestures. (2) The scene transitions through several straight cuts as she continues talking, her gestures becoming more varied. She points downwards towards her waist and then claps her hands together softly while maintaining eye contact with the camera. Subtitles in Traditional Chinese appear continuously at the bottom of the screen, tracking her spoken words accurately. The background lighting is even and bright, highlighting her facial expressions clearly. (3) She presents a small, white rectangular box to the camera lens, showcasing the brand text on its surface. She carefully opens the box and pulls out a pair of white, extremely thin underwear. She stretches the sheer fabric with both hands to demonstrate its remarkable thinness and elasticity against the ambient room light. The camera remains at eye-level throughout this product demonstration. (4) Holding the white underwear vertically, she points out specific design features like the seamless edges and the rear cut. She gives an enthusiastic thumbs up while holding the product near her face, smiling broadly. She then begins to wave the soft fabric quickly in front of the lens in an excited, playful manner to conclude the video segment.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To promote the brand '24HRS' by leveraging a past high-sales record and introducing a new 'buy one bra, get one free underwear' promotion. The video highlights the unique 'Face Mask' thinness and comfort features of the underwear to entice viewers to purchase during the promotional window.
